name: message-timestamps
description: Shows when messages were sent: at the end of Claude's last answer, on slash command output, and when you hover over your own messages. Uses a 24- or 12-hour clock.

reply_time.title: Where Claude's time goes
reply_time.description: At the bottom right of Claude's answer, or on its own line under it

hover_time.title: Time on hover over your messages
hover_time.description: In the desktop app, show the time when you hover over one of your own messages
